What are the key levels in play for the US dollar after the hotter than expected CPI
articles.expand: The US CPI came in higher than expectations and that has stocks lower, yields higher, and the dollar moving to the upside. Where are the problem areas? Energy is the immediate problem. Gasoline jumped 9.1% in September, following 3.9% in August. Fuel oil rose 15.3%, following 10.1%. Energy’s June and July declines have given way to substantial increases. Electricity and piped gas were much more contained in September. Services inflation is becoming firmer. Services excluding energy progressed from +0.2% in July to +0.3% in August and +0.4% in September. That steady acceleration is a concern be...

articles.title: Dollar Breaks Higher as Core CPI Pushes October Fed Hike Odds Above 40%
articles.expand: The Dollar surged broadly on Wednesday after September’s US core CPI beat expectations, reversing the recent retreat in Treasury yields. The Dollar Index broke above 102.60 to reach 102.72, the 2-year Treasury yield jumped toward 4.94% and the 10-year yield rebounded above 5.30%. According to CME FedWatch, the probability of a Fed hike at the October 28 meeting surged from 22.1% a day earlier to 43.7%, against 17.7% a week ago.
